positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Visual C++ Language Services

•	Authored wizard engine and framework to allow anyone with limited knowledge of UI technologies to create wizards that by default are themed, testable and accessible and.
•	Created converter to create Visual Studio projects for Office project sources.
•	Harnessed existing tests using distinct technologies and covering multiple feature areas into automated lab runs.
•	Notable features: Member List Filtering, Error Suggestions, XCode Object Model

positions.title: Senior Software Developer in Test
positions.description:
Visual C++ Language Services

•	Led the continual evolution and architectural changes of tests framework to include self-documented API’s that produce actionable failures by default and integrated it with additional frameworks and tools. 
•	Reduced the running time of our test bed by 45% and the raw number of tests by 60% while maintaining the same coverage.
•	Pioneered the telemetry drive and data analysis with the highlight being measuring the reliability of our out of process IntelliSense engine which in turned reduced and prioritized Watson reports.
•	Notable features: IntelliSense features for shared projects, incremental Find All References

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
positions.description:
Visual C++ Front End Compiler

•	Several improvements on running test automation on local developer machines, including creating a graphic interface for running and analyzing tests, environment setup and logging.
•	Improvements on automated lab runs such as crash handling, improved auto-analysis, and logging.
•	Subject matter expert on testing practices and frameworks
•	Notable features: 3D Graphic Tools, Squiggles, Semantic Colorization, XML Doc Comments

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
